diagnosis.premise: The closed exact 16x4 family remained 38.35% of the 4K trace. Source-faithful raw-Q8_0 x D4-Q8_1 MMQ changes activation algebra and matrix data reuse rather than retrying another exact local schedule.
diagnosis.source_leaf_screen: At 4K production shapes, one-pass MMQ plus activation packing was 73% to 89% faster than the retained exact leaves, but it was not quality-safe as a full-model replacement.

change.summary: Promote a registry-selected three-plane residual-D4 MMQ path with sparse exact BF16-boundary repair for two wide dense-Q8 projection shapes.

activation.plane_layout: K-major block_q8_1_mmq D4, 144 bytes per 128 values
activation.residual_rule: each later plane quantizes the FP32 fma residual left by the preceding plane

numerical_policy.risk_test: distance of the approximate FP32 MMQ value to the nearest BF16 rounding boundary
numerical_policy.repair: enqueue at-risk output indices and recompute those BF16 elements with the retained exact 128-thread raw-Q8 reduction
numerical_policy.claim_scope: Empirically bit-exact on the committed primitive/full-model gates and the 18-workload continuation suite; this is not a proof for every possible activation. Thresholds below 1e-5 are explicitly rejected.

admission.fallback: exact raw-Q8 tile16x4/tile8x4/tile8x2/pack8 family for every other shape or row count

memory.workspace: reuses bulk_prefill_scratch.linear_qkv_f32 inside the scoped prefill session
memory.persistent_addition: one int32 risk count plus an int32 queue with rows * 8192 entries
